evidence.quote: the Committee is likely to continue tapering our purchases in further measured steps over the remainder of this year.
as policy normalizes, forward guidance will be less commitment-like and, hence, a less precise guide to our future actions than it has been in the recent past.
So efforts to overly manage the market volatility associated with our communications may ultimately be self-defeating.
I think of myself as writing down not a commitment for where the federal funds rate will be at that time, but only my best forecast, and one that is highly uncertain at that.
